signals.title: LLM prices down up to 80% in three months, and IBM says open-weight is 90% as good at 10-25% of the cost
signals.summary: Luna cut ~80% (Jul), Opus 5.5 40-60% cheaper, GPT-6.1 family ~75% cheaper cumulatively; IBM CEO says open-weight on-prem is now 'irresistibly' cheap.
signals.run_with_it_note: List every loop that calls a model (reply drafts, review replies, EOD, night shift), tag each 'needs frontier' or 'classification/draft', and re-point the second group to the cheap tier or local Ollama. Measure the monthly bill before and after.

signals.title: Omnara: open-source (Apache 2.0) managed agent platform, resumable, Slack and MCP built in
signals.summary: Self-hostable alternative to Claude Managed Agents. Every step saved to Postgres so agents resume after crashes, with per-tool approve/auto/block permissions.
signals.run_with_it_note: docker compose it on mbp-2 (it already runs Docker). Move ONE flaky launchd loop (loop watchdog or EOD charges) into it and see if approvals land in Slack from the phone.

signals.title: The rise of one-person travel businesses (FareHarbor and Bokun named as the plumbing)
signals.summary: Skift counts ~20 solo-operator models; software now handles messaging, pricing, dispatch. Travel VC funding also fell a second straight quarter.
signals.run_with_it_note: Package the 3 tools you already run (FH daily brief, review SMS, GBP poster) as a one-page 'solo tour operator stack' and show it to 5 Tourpreneur-type operators. Count who asks for it.

signals.title: NVIDIA OpenShell: safe private runtime for fleets of autonomous agents
signals.summary: 503 HN points. Sandboxed runtime for agent fleets. Overlaps with Omnara and last week's Agent37.

signals.title: Stripe Treasury for agents
signals.summary: Agents (Claude, ChatGPT) can check balances, pay invoices, move money, via Stripe MCP, with human-approval gates. Cards and spend limits still 'coming'.

signals.title: Anthropic donates Agent Skills standard to the Agentic AI Foundation (Linux Foundation)
signals.summary: Skills become a vendor-neutral standard alongside MCP, so skills you write are less likely to be stranded.

signals.title: 1Password for Agents
signals.summary: Credential handling for agents, relevant to the secrets-in-synced-vault problem. Not read in full.

signals.title: Travel VC funding fell a second straight quarter; AI travel rounds cut in half
signals.summary: Seed climate in travel is cooling, which means fewer funded AI booking startups and more room for operators to own the direct relationship.

signals.title: A 10-year-old CNN beats frontier LLMs at skin-cancer diagnosis
signals.summary: 586 HN points. Small purpose-built models still beat general LLMs on narrow tasks.

signals.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro
signals.summary: Another open-weight contender feeding the price pressure above.

signals.title: Claude text output now carries an invisible watermark
signals.summary: Per O'Reilly, recent Claude models embed text watermarks. Unverified here; matters for 'sounds human' content.

signals.title: Climate-tech seed: no October rounds found; June leaders Terraform Industries ($37.75M) and Voltify ($30M)
signals.summary: Subwatch again quiet. Money concentrating into fewer, larger rounds.
